title: UI wave 3 K2: Wire shortcuts into the app and Settings
description: Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-28-ui-wave-3/PLAN.md section K2 exactly (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) and read its Context, Rules and Notes for the implementer first; RESEARCH.md beside it has the evidence. House rules: register paths = this task's seeded Files (already registered on claim; add more only via files add); serial slot (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot) via files add right before the first expensive check and keep it until done; pinned Node; quoted --outDir on PREVIEW port 1600+N; never edit docs/design-system.md (write DESIGN DOC: text in the done note); motion checks in tests/motion-uN.spec.ts; native rendering runs only with the screen unlocked, by Claude agents or the owner; never put backticks in double-quoted shell text; no installs, no commits; status CLAIMED; independent review required.

review.note: Reviewed K2 diff (App keydown, Writer handleKeyDown, shortcutHints, ShortcutsSettings, css, spec). tsc 0; vitest src/shortcuts src/editor 103 pass; pw.log 24/24 newer than sources (05:20 vs 05:17); pw-failfirst.log shows rebind and refusal cases fail on doctored copy. All 9 app chords route through resolveChord; no input-typing guard existed before or after; Ctrl folds to Cmd. Cmd+Shift+S now snapshot only (intended). kbd has no fill; Esc cancels recording (capture handler, code-read; not covered by a test). Playwright not rerun: serial slot owned by T153. Non-blocking: Cmd+Shift+S test does not prove save is not fired; resolveChord unit test maps the chord to snapshot only, which covers it adequately. Minor: old handler also fired on Alt/extra-modifier variants; now exact match only.

log.note: K2 done (CLAIMED). All app-owned chords now dispatch through N1 resolveChord: App.tsx window keydown (save, toggleSidebar, findInProject, newSection, snapshot, toggleAppearance) and Writer.tsx handleKeyDown (focusMode, keepAsFragment); Writer takes a shortcuts prop (App holds the overrides in state, persisted via writeShortcuts under folio.workspace.shortcuts). editor/shortcuts.ts adds shortcutHints(overrides) so More-menu hints (Focus mode, Keep as fragment, Insert page break) follow rebinds; static aria-labels untouched. ShortcutsSettings mounted as children of GeneralSettings inside its own settings-section with an h2 Shortcuts, so it shows in both Settings and the Projects-screen dialog. Chord is now a kbd (new src/settings/shortcuts-settings.css, tokens only, no fills). Insert page break stays read-only Shift+Enter. ActionIds needed no change (all 9 map to real handlers). No Tiptap collision found for default chords. BEHAVIOUR CHANGE (intended fix): Cmd+Shift+S now fires only snapshot, not save plus snapshot. Evidence: tsc clean; vitest src/shortcuts src/editor 103 pass; Playwright shortcuts, editor-toolbar, features, accessibility 24/24 (port 1648, log node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-k2/pw.log). Fail-first on a doctored copy (overrides ignored): rebind and refusal/Reset-all cases fail (pw-failfirst.log); the Cmd+Shift+S case passes both ways (it only asserts the snapshot dialog opens). Paths added: src/settings/ShortcutsSettings.tsx, src/settings/shortcuts-settings.css. DESIGN DOC: Settings > Shortcuts lists each action with its chord in a quiet kbd (small, muted, tabular, no fill), Change records the next chord (Esc cancels), refuses macOS-reserved chords and chords taken by another action with an inline status line, Reset per row and Reset all; Insert page break (Shift+Return) is listed read-only; overrides persist in folio.workspace.shortcuts; menu hints reflect rebinds.
